serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Bentley Systems is a provider of infrastructure engineering software. Bentley for Government software solutions enable efficient planning, design, construction, and operation of critical public infrastructure assets. Bentley is committed to ensuring infrastructure engineers working for U.S. government agencies and contractors have access to secure cloud-connected software solutions that meet federal standards for confidentiality, integrity, and availability.

 

ProjectWise, part of Bentley Infrastructure Cloud, is a collaborative information management solution empowering engineering firms, construction contractors, departments of transportation, and federal agencies to share data and streamline workflows across project phases for more efficient, safer, and faster infrastructure project delivery.

 

OpenGround is a secure, cloud-based geotechnical information management solution for collecting, managing, analyzing, reporting and sharing geotechnical data. OpenGround offers secure, enterprise-grade geotechnical data management and reporting, trusted by engineering consultants, departments of transportation, and federal agencies to enable collaboration at every stage of the ground investigation lifecycle.
